findings.description: STREET_ADDRESS labels include city, postcode or country despite the street-line-only convention. Overlapping ZIP_CODE annotations also need an explicit scoring policy.
The account handle mcarthur.patricia is PERSON gold; Smith and Jones families are a hard negative. Maintainers should explicitly review PERSON versus USERNAME and household-name handling.
Default browser Small uses person -> PERSON and address -> ADDRESS (full span). Native STREET_ADDRESS results and prompt/threshold-dependent scores cannot qualify this export.

Do not pool partially PERSON/address-labelled legacy detector corpora and call every model prediction a false positive. This preparation set completely annotates its declared scored types and keeps other findings visible but unscored.

disposition: Reviewed definitions only. Selected shape/Unicode scenarios informed an independent preparation corpus; candidate native baseline/scoring implementation was not imported or merged. Final corpus/policy approval is still required.
